name: China Wire & Cable Co., Ltd.
summary: China Wire & Cable Co., Ltd. engages in the manufacture, design, installation and sale of aluminum structure and profiles. Its products include wires, cables, aluminum doors, aluminum windows, curtain walls and electrical & metal products. The company also engages in the real estate business. China Wire & Cable was founded on February 23, 1961 and is headquartered in Taipei, Taiwan.
